video_title: Tuomas Iisalo Press Conference | Grizzlies vs. Clippers

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Zack Edey's second half absence due to soreness
quotes.excerpt: He had some soreness at the end of the second quarter and we decided it's better
quotes.quote: He had some soreness at the end of the second quarter and we decided it's better that he doesn't play in the second half.
quotes.social_post: Zach Edey was held out of the second half of tonight's game due to soreness. Tuomas Iisalo said the decision was made after Edey reported the issue at the end of the second quarter.

structured.context: Head coach Tuomas Iisalo explains why Zack Edey did not play in the second half of the game against the Clippers due to soreness.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Grizzlies' ability to win without shooting well from three
quotes.excerpt: These are very important wins because it shows you that we are robust enough to take care
quotes.quote: These are very important wins because it shows you that we are robust enough to take care of business without having to make shots. That's the worst feeling as a coach if you're coaching a team where you're like, 'Hey, we got to make shots tonight to win the game,' because then you're at the mercy of that. So the opposite of that is winning without making shots. That's a very sustainable way and I loved how our guys competed.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo on the Grizzlies winning despite poor shooting: It is the worst feeling as a coach if you feel like you have to make shots to win. Winning without making shots is a very sustainable way to play.

structured.context: Tuomas Iisalo discusses the importance of the team being able to win games even when they are not shooting well from three-point range.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Murray's role and growth as a starter
quotes.excerpt: We just play better when he's out there which is what ultimately playing basketball is about
quotes.quote: We just play better when he's out there which is what ultimately playing basketball is about. You're one of five guys who's out there and you try to help the team win as much as possible and he's really doing that. He's doing it through excellent point-of-attack defense. In Charlotte it was Brandon Miller, today it was Ingram, really limiting their touches, limiting their efficiency, helping with the rebounding, creating disruption defensively, so contributing to the possession game. And then offensively, he's becoming more and more fluent in how we play.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo says Chris Murray is making a major impact through his point of attack defense. He noted that Murray has been tasked with limiting top scorers like Brandon Miller and Brandon Ingram recently.

structured.context: Tuomas Iisalo praises Chris Murray for his defensive impact against Brandon Miller and Brandon Ingram and his overall growth as a starter.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Spencer's efficiency and consistency off the bench
quotes.excerpt: Efficiency is definitely producing in an efficient way. He's been unreal with his shot making
quotes.quote: Efficiency is definitely producing in an efficient way. He's been unreal with his shot making and again tonight, two for four, seven for ten from the field. He gives us, they both give us, if you look at Ty and Javon and Cam, all of them are very good shooters from the three-point line, also off the dribble, so that forces some reads from the other team and it's really a hard choice for them now.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo on the bench production of Cam Spencer, Ty, and Javon: Their ability to shoot off the dribble forces difficult reads from the opposing defense.

structured.context: Tuomas Iisalo highlights the shooting efficiency and offensive versatility provided by Cam Spencer, Ty, and Javon off the bench.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Spencer's improved decision-making and risk-taking
quotes.excerpt: His turnovers are up this year and I'm super excited about that because last year I thought
quotes.quote: His turnovers are up this year and I'm super excited about that because last year I thought he was a bit risk-averse and he had extremely high assist-to-turnover ratio. We talked about this during the off-season and heading into this season that that's one of the things where he can improve. The best creators have higher turnover numbers because they also look for the higher leverage, the higher value passes and he's had multiple of those where he skips it to the other side instead of making the safest pass.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo says he is actually excited that Cam Spencer's turnovers are up this year. He explained that Spencer was too risk averse last season and is now making higher value passes.

structured.context: Tuomas Iisalo explains why he is pleased with Cam Spencer's increased turnover numbers, viewing them as a sign of more aggressive playmaking.

quotes.speaker: Tuomas Iisalo
quotes.summary_phrase: Zack Edey's role in communicating his injury status
quotes.excerpt: Of course he would say that first. We are not there every minute asking how his ankle
quotes.quote: Of course he would say that first. We are not there every minute asking how his ankle is doing so he relayed that message and then the decision was made.
quotes.social_post: Tuomas Iisalo clarifies that the decision to sit Zach Edey was based on the player communicating his own status: We are not there every minute asking how his ankle is doing so he relayed that message.

structured.context: Tuomas Iisalo clarifies that the decision to sit Zack Edey was based on the player communicating his ankle soreness to the coaching staff.
